site.note: Generalised profile for Witkowo (gm. Stargard). Upper 100 m from SMGP sheet 268 Dolice text + CBDG boreholes Witkowo I (0.1 km), Pyrzyce-Kluczewo 01/06 (4 km W), Kolin (5.5 km S); deep part regional (SMGP text, Dolice borehole 82, Stargard GT wells 9 km NW).
site.note_ref: Site = canopies (data/geo/site.json); geology research point was the Agrofirma farmyard ~0.85 km SE, same till plain.

layers.age_pl: plejstocen, zlodowacenie Wisły, faza pomorska (~17-16 tys. lat)

layers.lithology: yellow-brown to grey sandy-silty till with pebbles, decalcified to ~1 m

layers.name_pl: Piaski i żwiry wodnolodowcowe (górny poziom międzyglinowy)
layers.name_en: Meltwater sand and gravel (upper inter-till aquifer)
layers.lithology: fine to medium sand with gravel

layers.name_pl: Glina zwałowa i mułki zastoiskowe (zlodowacenia Wisły / Warty)
layers.name_en: Older till and ice-dammed lake silt
layers.lithology: grey compact till; grey silty-clayey silt with mica
layers.age: Pleistocene, Vistulian middle stadial to Saalian (Warta)
layers.age_pl: plejstocen, stadiał środkowy Wisły - zlodowacenie Warty

layers.range_base_m: 79.5 (top of the Q aquifer in Witkowo-4)
layers.lithology: dark grey till with pebbles and gravel at base

layers.range_base_m: 96-98 (Witkowo-4 Q to 96 m; Tertiary from 98 m, MHP)
layers.name_pl: Piaski wodnolodowcowe (głęboki poziom czwartorzędowy, studnia Witkowo-4)
layers.name_en: Deep Quaternary meltwater sand (aquifer tapped by well Witkowo-4)
Miocene sands and silts with lignite seams
layers.lithology: grey-brown fine quartz sand, micaceous carbonaceous silt, lignite 0.5-1 m seams
layers.note_pl: strop ze studni (Witkowo-4, MHP: od 98 m); Witkowo-1A 127 m w miocenie
layers.note_en: top from wells (Witkowo-4, MHP: from 98 m); Witkowo-1A 127 m in Miocene

layers.range_base_m: few-30 m thick, may be absent
layers.name_en: Glauconitic marine clays and sands (Eocene, Oligocene)

layers.name_pl: Margle, wapienie margliste i kreda pisząca (kreda górna)
layers.name_en: Late Cretaceous marl, marly limestone and chalk
layers.lithology: white/grey marl, marly limestone with inocerams

layers.name_pl: Mułowce i piaskowce (jura); piaskowce jury dolnej = zbiornik geotermalny Stargardu (~2,5 km)
layers.name_en: Jurassic mudstones and sandstones; Lower Jurassic sandstone = Stargard geothermal aquifer (~2.5 km)

layers.name_pl: Trias (retyk i starsze), u spągu sole cechsztynu
layers.name_en: Triassic, Zechstein salt at the base

groundwater.main_aquifer: Quaternary inter-till sands, confined; MHP 268 mean thickness 11.2 / 15.6 m (units 3 / 1); deep Q aquifer 79.5-96 m in Witkowo-4

piezometric_level_m.source: MHP 1:50 000 ark. 268 Dolice (PIG 2004), units 3 QIIb/Q and 1 QIIab/Tr: static level 1.2-14.5 m bgl

groundwater.well_yield_m3h: 50-120 (MHP potential yield classes at the village)
groundwater.gzwp: GZWP 123 Stargard-Goleniow (Quaternary, 15-58 m), village ~1.1 km outside its southern tip

hypothetical_well.note: hypothetical irrigation well into the upper inter-till aquifer (10-24 m); real Agrofirma wells: Witkowo-4 96 m (Q 79.5-96), Witkowo-1A 127 m (Miocene)

sources: PIG-PIB: SMGP 1:50 000 ark. 268 Dolice (Sochan, Piotrowski 2004), MGSP 268 (Madry et al. 2009), CBDG boreholes
